name: Globetrotter
intro:
class="page-content">
Where these people hail from is unknown, but supposedly they are unsatisfied with watching fate run its course and have decided to take matters into their own hands. Eschewing spellcasting entirely, they instead carry their star globe, usually a tool used mostly for divination, as if it were an orb of power. Paired with a weapon in their other hand, these explorers look to the heavens for guidance while traveling the world in their search of destiny.
The globetrotter is an archetype of the astrologian class.
Archetype Main Ability Scores:
The globetrotter primarily focuse

features.name: Class Skills
features.text:
The globetrotter adds Acrobatics, Intimidate, Survival, Swim, and Use Magic Device to her list of class skills.
This ability replaces Appraise, Knowledge (Nobility, Engineering, Technology) and Linguistics as class skills.

features.name: Expert Prowess
features.text:
A globetrotter’s base attack bonus increases by two steps (from 1/2 BAB to Full BAB). Also increases the globetrotter’s hit dice from d6 to d10. In addition, the globetrotters’s Fortitude save progression becomes good.
This ability replaces cantrips, spells, and MP Pool. Globetrotters do not gain any spells or spellcasting ability, do not have a caster level, and do not count as having an astrologian spell list for spell trigger or spell completion magic items.

features.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
features.text:
The globetrotter gains proficiency with all one-handed simple and martial weapons, and gains proficiency with light and medium armor. She loses proficiency with all power weapons.
This ability modifies the globetrotter’s starting weapon and armor proficiencies.

features.name: Limit Break
features.text:
At 1st level, the globetrotter receives the Limit Break (Lesser Orb of Annihilation).
Lesser Orb of Annihilation (Su): This Limit Break allows the globetrotter to concentrate the energies of the universe into the center of her star globe, forming an absolutely black sphere. For a duration of 1 round + 1 round per four astrologian levels after 1st, when the globetrotter hits with her star globe, if it’s not an attack of opportunity, it pulls her target adjacent to her unless they succeed on a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of the astrologian’s level + her Wisdom modifier). Regardless of whether the pull succeeds or not, the destabilization causes them to provoke an attack of opportunity that can be taken before or after the pull. This limit break requires only a swift action.
This ability replaces the Limit Break (Kinetic Card).

features.name: Precise Shot
features.text:
The globetrotter gains Precise Shot as a bonus feat without meeting the prerequisites.
This ability replaces spell proficiency.

features.name: Warrior Talents
features.text:
The globetrotter can pick warrior talents in place of astrology secrets, using her astrologian level for warrior level prerequisites. She treats her star globe as her chosen weapon for the purpose of warrior talents. At 12th level, she may pick advanced warrior talents as well. Additionally, the level requirements for the Additional Globe and Extra Additional Globe astrology secrets are lowered to 6 and 12 respectively.
This ability may replace astrology secrets and advanced astrology secrets.

features.name: Star Combat
features.text:
At 3rd level, the globetrotter may use her star globe in tandem with a melee weapon. This functions much like two-weapon fighting, but the off-hand weapon is her star globe. As a full-attack action, she can make her star globe attacks in addition to all of her normal melee weapon attacks, though all attacks made this way take a –2 penalty. If the globetrotter has class features that let her make extra attacks with her star globe, she may use them as part of this full attack.
This ability replaces lightspeed.

features.name: Infused Star Globe
features.text:
At 5th level, the globetrotter’s star globe becomes more akin to a real weapon. She may have her star globe enhanced permanently as if it was a ranged weapon (it cannot/does not need to be masterworked beforehand), though she needs to be present for the entire process as it disappears if it leaves her hands. She may also use her level as her caster level for qualifying and using feats.
This ability replaces clear mind.

features.name: The Heavenly Paths
features.text:
At 5th level, early on in the globetrotter’s studies, she learns about two different sects that map the stars using the positions of the sun and the moon and these two sects are reflective of their reference points. The Diurnal Sect uses the sun as their reference point, creating star maps with the sun being the key to navigation, while the Nocturnal Sect uses the moon as the reference point. The globetrotter imbues herself with a specific sect and draws the powers from them. She may switch between sects as a swift action.
• Diurnal Sect (Su): The globetrotter’s star globe explodes on hit, dealing its minimum damage to adjacent enemies, Reflex for half (DC 10 + half of the astrologian’s level + her Wisdom modifier).
• Nocturnal Sect (Su): The globetrotter gains a bonus to her melee damage rolls equal to her Wisdom modifier.
This ability modifies the heavenly paths.

features.name: Essential Fortune
features.text:
At 6th level, the globetrotter’s cards become more potent when affecting those in need. As long as an ally is below 50% health, all cards from the globetrotter that affect them have their total effect increased by 1.
This ability replaces essential dignity.

features.name: Astral Safety
features.text:
At 7th level, the globetrotter does not provoke attacks of opportunity when making attacks with her star globe.
This ability replaces astral guidance.

features.name: Synastry
features.text:
At 9th level, the globetrotter can create an aetheric bond with an ally. As a move action or swift action, the astrologian can choose an ally (she cannot chose herself) within 30 feet to bond with. Whenever the globetrotter deals damage with her star globe, the bonded ally heals for half the damage dealt. This ability lasts for a number of rounds equal to the globetrotter’s Wisdom modifier and is usable up to 3 times per day.
This ability modifies synastry.

features.name: Conduit of Heaven
features.text:
At 13th level, when an ally casts a single-target spell that is 2nd-level or higher on the globetrotter, that ally regains 1 MP. The spell must cost at least 2 MP or higher to regain MP.
This ability replaces far seer.

features.name: Touch of the Moon
features.text:
At 14th level, while under the Nocturnal Sect, the globetrotter’s star globe carries with it a taint of madness. Subjects who take damage from it are also subject to confusion, as the spell, except the duration of this effect is 1 round. The Will save DC against this effect is 10 + half of the astrologian’s level + her Wisdom modifier.
This modifies the touch of the moon sect power.

features.name: Curve Ray
features.text:
At 17th level, the globetrotter may hit targets that are outside her line of fire. Her attacks with her star globe ignore all cover, including total cover. The star globe’s ray must still be able to reach the target; a target inside a closed building with no open doors or windows cannot be attacked.
This ability replaces read the stars.

features.name: Destiny Realized
features.text:
At 19th level, the globetrotter’s moment of destiny is at hand. Any critical threats made against her only confirm if the second roll results in a natural 20 on the die. Any critical threats she scores with her star globe are automatically confirmed. Additionally, once per day, she can cast Discern Location as a spell-like ability, with a cast time of 10 minutes.
This ability modifies destiny realized.

name: Herald of Woe
intro:
class="page-content">
While astrologians may be viewed as benevolent or aloof fortune tellers, heralds of woe are better known as cold harbingers of misfortune—though some might go so far as to say that the heralds are themselves the cause of their ill tidings.
The herald of woe is an archetype of the astrologian class.
Archetype Main Ability Scores:
The herald of woe mainly focuses on DEX for combat and WIS for their class features and spellcasting, as well as CHA for an optional class feature.
Archetype Feature Replacements:
1st – Draw. 4th – Royal Road. 5th – The Heavenly Paths, Minor Arcan

features.name: Draw
features.text:
At 1st level, a herald of woe utilizes a special deck of tarot cards that float around her star globe. As a swift action, she may draw a card at random, rolling a 1d6 (see below). Once drawn, a herald may imbue the effects of the card on a single target within 30 feet. At 5th level and every four levels thereafter, the number of targets on which the herald may use a card increases by 1 and the range by 10 feet. The target of Draw must make a save of the appropriate type with a DC of 10 + half the herald’s level + her Wisdom modifier. If the target fails the save, then the effect takes hold and lasts for a number of rounds equal to the herald’s Wisdom modifier. The herald may use this ability a number of times per day equal to her astrologian level + her Wisdom modifier.
• 
The Crow (Su): The target is inflicted with the Blinded status effect, a Fortitude save negates.
• 
The Bat (Su): The target is inflicted with the Confused status effect, a Will save negates.
• 
The Scorpion (Su): The target is inflicted with the Poisoned status effect, a Fortitude save negates.
• 
The Serpent (Su): The target is inflicted with the Shaken status effect, a Will save negates.
• 
The Goat (Su): The target is inflicted with the Silenced status effect, a Will save negates.
• 
The Spider (Su): The target is inflicted with the Slow status effect, a Fortitude save negates.
This ability modifies draw.

features.name: Road of the Damned
features.text:
At 4th level, the herald’s understanding of fortune telling has grown considerably, allowing her to augment her tarot cards further. After she uses the Draw ability, she may use a free action to convert that card into an empowerment for a future reading. This empowerment affects the next card that the herald uses to weaken an enemy, from either the Draw ability or Spread ability.
• 
If the Bat or the Scorpion card is drawn, the enemy affected also takes damage equal to the herald’s Wisdom modifier.
• 
If the Crow or the Goat card is drawn, the duration is doubled.
• 
If the Serpent or the Spider card is drawn, enemies within a 20-ft.-radius of the Herald of Woe also become targets of the played card.
This ability replaces royal road.

features.name: Minor Woe
features.text:
At 5th level, as a free action, whenever the herald of woe draws a card, she can spend two additional charges of it (to a total of 3) to convert it into the Lord of Woes when Crow, Bat, or Scorpion or the Lady of Woes when Serpent, Goat, or Spider.
• Lord of Woes (Su): This card grants the status effects of all three cards of Crow, Bat, and Scorpion.
• 
Lady of Woes (Su): This card grants the status effects of all three cards of Serpent, Goat, and Spider.
This ability modifies and replaces minor arcana.

features.name: The Heavenly Paths
features.text:
At 5th level, early on in the herald’s studies, she learns about two different sects that map the stars using the positions of the sun and the moon and these two sects are reflective of their reference points. The Diurnal Sect uses the sun as their reference point, creating star maps with the sun being the key to navigation, while the Nocturnal Sect uses the moon as the reference point. The herald imbues herself with a specific sect and draws the powers from them. The herald may switch between sects as a swift action.
• 
Diurnal Sect (Su): The herald is able to empower her debuffing or status inflicting spells with the power of the sun. When she casts a spell that inflicts a status effect on an enemy, she may leave a vampiric effect. After the spell is cast, enemies affected suffer bleeding damage equal to the spell’s level for a number of rounds equal to the herald’s Wisdom modifier. The herald also gains temporary hit points equal to the damage taken by her enemy for a number of rounds equal to the herald’s Wisdom modifier; however, the herald may only receive hit points from a number of afflicted enemies up to her Wisdom modifier. Multiple debuffing or status inflicting spells do not stack, but refreshes the duration.
• 
Nocturnal Sect (Su): The herald is able to empower her debuffing or status inflicting spells with the power of the moon. When she casts a spell that inflicts a status effect on an enemy, she may leave a weakening effect. After the spell is cast, enemies affected suffer additional points of damage (whenever they receive damage) equal to the spell’s level for a number of rounds equal to the herald’s Wisdom modifier. Multiple debuffing or status inflicting spells do not stack, but refreshes the duration.
This ability modifies the heavenly paths.

features.name: Woeful Countenance
features.text:
At 6th level, the herald’s portents become harder to dismiss. When an enemy’s health is below 50%, it takes a -2 penalty to its saves against the herald’s spells and abilities. At 12th level, the penalty increases to -4.
This ability replaces essential dignity.

features.name: Synastry
features.text:
At 9th level, the herald can create an aetheric bond with an enemy.
As a move action, the herald can choose an enemy within 60 feet to bond with. Any debuffing or status inflicting spells the herald casts that successfully targets a creature not affected by the bond will also inflict the same condition on the bonded enemy for half of the duration inflicted on the target. In addition, upon failing a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half the astrologian’s level + her Wisdom modifier), the enemy is inflicted with the Sapped status effect while it suffers from the bond’s effects. This ability lasts for a number of rounds equal to the herald’s Wisdom modifier and is usable a number of times per day equal to her Wisdom modifier.
This ability modifies synastry.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.text:
At 10th level, the herald can bestow a powerful effect on her enemies. All cards drawn gain a +1 bonus on Save DCs to inflict negative statuses for each drawn card in effect. At 15th and 20th level, this bonus increases by 1 for each drawn card in effect. This ability lasts for a number of rounds equal to her Wisdom modifier and the herald can use this ability a number of times per day equal to her Wisdom modifier.
This ability replaces divination.

features.name: The Oncoming Storm
features.text:
At 18th level, the herald creates a 60-ft.-radius dome over herself, centered on her. It lasts a number of rounds equal to her Wisdom modifier, and while inside the dome, all enemies suffer the effects of one of her Draw tarot cards (determined by rolling a 1d6 as normal unless the herald uses Spread or Shuffle), and their damage taken is increased by 50%. The effects of the card persist for their normal duration after either the dome falls or the enemy leaves the dome. If an enemy was already suffering from the card’s effect, then its duration is extended and then refreshed after either the dome falls or the enemy leaves the dome. The herald must concentrate on this ability as a full-round action each round; otherwise, the ability stops. This ability is usable only once per day, even if it ended prematurely.
This ability replaces collective unconscious.

features.name: Omen of Entropy
features.text:
At 20th level, even gods and divine beings quake in fear at the walking catastrophe that the herald has become. He ignores other creatures’ immunities when applying status effects with his Astrologian spells and abilities.
This ability replaces master astrologian.

name: Lantern-Bearer
intro:
class="page-content">
Tonkins bear lanterns to guard and light the way. Lantern-bearers devote themselves and harness the power of the lanterns to fight the darkness.
The lantern-bearer is an archetype of the astrologian class, available only to tonkin astrologians.
Archetype Main Ability Scores:
The lantern–bearer mainly focuses on DEX and WIS for combat with Lantern’s Light and WIS for their class features and spell–like abilities.
Archetype Feature Replacements:
1st – Armor Proficiencies, BAB, MP Pool, Spells, Cantrips, Draw, Limit Break (Kinetic Card), Star Globe. 2nd – Astrology Secret. 3

features.name: Armor Proficiency
features.text:
Lantern-bearers are proficient with light armor, but not shields.
This ability modifies the astrologian’s starting armor proficiencies.

features.name: Limit Break
features.text:
At 1st level, the lantern-bearer receives the Limit Break (Empowered Lights).
Empowered Lights (Su): This Limit Break empowers the lantern-bearer’s lantern’s light with extreme power. For a duration of 1 round + 1 round per four astrologian levels after 1st, the lantern-bearer rerolls any 1’s and 2’s with his lantern’s lights damage rolls and his critical threat range of his lantern’s light increases by 1 + 1 per four astrologian levels after 1st. This limit break requires only a swift action.
This ability replaces the Limit Break (Kinetic Card).

features.name: Martial Prowess
features.text:
A lantern-bearer’s base attack bonus increases by one step (from 1/2 BAB to 3/4 BAB). Also increases lantern-bearer’s hit dice from d6 to d8.
This ability replaces star globe.

features.name: Lantern’s Light
features.text:
At 1st level, a lantern-bearer attacks his foes with the lantern’s power, using light magical energy to deal damage and, sometimes, impart other debilitating effects. A lantern’s light is a ray with a range of 60 feet. It is a ranged touch attack that affects a single target. A lantern’s light deals 1d8 points of holy damage at 1st level and increases by 1d8 for every two levels thereafter. The lantern-bearer also adds his Wisdom modifier to his lantern’s holy damage. The target must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of the astrologian’s level + his Wisdom modifier) or become dazzled for 1 round per astrologian level. A lantern-bearer can apply one light shape enhancement and one holy essence enhancement (until 6th level)to the same light. A lantern’s light counts as a weapon-like ability for the purpose of applying feats. A lantern’s light deals half damage to objects and can’t be used with Vital Strike feats.
This ability replaces spells, cantrips, and MP pool. Lantern-bearers do not gain any spells or spellcasting ability, do not have a caster level, and do not count as having an astrologian spell list for spell trigger or spell completion magic items.

features.name: Lantern’s Light Enhancement
features.text:
At 1st level, and every two levels thereafter, a lantern-bearer learns to enhance his lantern’s light ability. Unless otherwise noted, a lantern-bearer cannot select an individual lantern’s light enhancement more than once. Some lantern’s light enhancements can only be chosen if the lantern-bearer has met certain prerequisites first. Some lantern’s light enhancements that are marked with an asterisk (*) modify the range, target(s), or area of a lantern-bearer’s lantern’s light. These are called light shape enhancements. Light shape enhancements do not stack, only one can be applied to an individual light. Some lantern’s light enhancements that are marked with two asterisks (**) modify the damage or other effects of the lantern-bearer’s lantern’s light. These are called holy essence enhancements. Holy essence enhancements do not stack, only one can be applied to an individual light until 6th level and replaces the dazzled effect. A lantern-bearer can apply one light shape enhancement and one holy essence enhancement to an individual light. The DC of any saving throw called for by a lantern’s light enhancement is equal to 10 + half of the astrologian’s level + his Wisdom modifier.
Bewitching Light** (Su): This holy essence enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to change his lantern’s light into a bewitching light. Any creature struck by a bewitching light must succeed on a Will save or be confused for 1 round per astrologian level. This is a mind influencing effect. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 11th level before selecting this enhancement.
Binding Light** (Su): This holy essence enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to change his lantern’s light into a binding light. Any creature struck by a binding light must succeed on a Will save or be stunned for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting effect. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 7th level before selecting this enhancement.
Blinding Light** (Su): This holy essence enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to change his lantern’s light into a blinding light. Any living creature struck by a blinding light must succeed on a Fortitude save or be blinded for 1 round per astrologian level.
Deteriorating Light** (Su): This holy essence enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to change his lantern’s light into a deteriorating light. Any creature struck by a deteriorating light must succeed on a Fortitude save or have its damage reduction lowered by 5 for 1 round per astrologian level. If the target has more than one type of damage reduction, this effect applies to all of them. Multiple uses of this essence don’t stack; instead, the new duration replaces the old one. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 7th level before selecting this enhancement.
Frightful Light** (Su): This holy essence enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to change his lantern’s light into a frightful light. Any creature struck by a frightful light must succeed on a Will save or become frighten for 1 minute. A frightened creature struck by a frightful light is not affected by the frighten aspect of the light but takes damage normally. Creatures with immunity to mind-affecting spells and abilities or fear effects cannot be frightened by a frightful light. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 7th level before selecting this enhancement.
Hammer Light** (Su): This holy essence enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to change his lantern’s light into a hammer light. A hammer light deals normal damage to objects, rather than half.
Hindering Light** (Su): This holy essence enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to change his lantern’s light into a hindering light. Any living creature struck by a hindering light must succeed on a Will save or be slowed for 1 round per astrologian level in addition to the normal damage from the light. Multiple slow effects don’t stack. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 5th level before selecting this enhancement.
Holy Chain* (Su): This light shape enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to improve his lantern’s light by turning it into an arc of holy energy that “jumps” from the first target to others. A holy chain can jump to one secondary target per 5 lantern-bearer levels within 30 feet of the previous one, allowing the lantern-bearer to make additional ranged touch attacks and deal damage to the secondary targets if you hit. The lantern-bearer can’t target the same creature more than once with the holy chain. If he misses any target in the chain, the holy chain attack ends there. Each target struck after the first takes half the damage dealt to the first target. The lantern-bearer must make a separate spell penetration check for each target, if applicable. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 7th level before selecting this enhancement.
Holy Cone* (Su): This light shape enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to invoke his lantern’s light as a 30-foot cone. The holy cone deals the normal lantern’s light damage to all targets within the area. This is not a ray attack, so it requires no ranged touch attack. Any creature in the area of the cone can attempt a Reflex save for half damage. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 5th level before selecting this enhancement.
Holy Doom* (Su): This light shape enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to invoke his lantern’s light as the dreaded holy doom. This causes bolts of holy power to lash out and savage nearby targets. A holy doom deals lantern’s light damage to any number of targets designated by the lantern-bearer and within 20 feet. This is not a ray attack, so it requires no ranged touch attack. Each target can attempt a Reflex save for half damage. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 7th level before selecting this enhancement.
Holy Explosion* (Su): This light shape enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to invoke his lantern’s light as a 20-ft.-radius burst anywhere within 60 feet. The holy explosion deals the normal lantern’s light damage to all targets within the area. This is not a ray attack, so it requires no ranged touch attack. Any creature in the area of the cone can attempt a Reflex save for half damage. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 4th level before selecting this enhancement.
Holy Line* (Su): This light shape enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to invoke his lantern’s light as a 60-foot line. A holy line deals the normal lantern’s light damage to all targets within the area. This is not a ray attack, so it requires no ranged touch attack. Any creature in the line can attempt a Reflex save for half damage. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 5th level before selecting this enhancement.
Holy Spear* (Su): This light shape enhancement extends the lantern-bearer’s lantern’s light attacks to great distances. holy spear increases the range of a lantern’s light attack to 250 feet with no range increment.
Noxious Light** (Su): This holy essence enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to change his lantern’s light into a noxious light. Any creature struck by a noxious light must make a Fortitude save or be nauseated for 1 round per astrologian level. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 5th level before selecting this enhancement.
Penetrating Light** (Su): This holy essence enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to change his lantern’s light into a penetrating light. A creature affected by a penetrating light must succeed on a Will save or have its spell resistance lowered by 5 for 1 round per astrologian level. Multiple uses of this essence don’t stack; instead, the new duration replaces the old one. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 9th level before selecting this enhancement.
Repelling Light** (Su): This holy essence enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to change his lantern’s light into a repelling light. Any Medium or smaller creature struck by a repelling light must make a Reflex save or be hurled 1d6×5 feet (1d6 squares) directly away from the lantern-bearer and knocked prone by the energy of the attack. If the creature strikes a solid object, it stops prematurely, taking 1d6 points of damage per 10 feet hurled, and it is still knocked prone. Movement from this light does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 3rd level before selecting this enhancement.
Sickening Light** (Su): This holy essence enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to change his lantern’s light into a sickening light. Any living creature struck by a sickening light must make a Fortitude save or become sickened for 1 round per astrologian level. A sickened creature struck by a second sickening light is not affected by the sickening aspect of the light but still takes damage normally.
Spirit Light** (Su): This holy essence enhancement allows the lantern-bearer to change his lantern’s light into a spirit light. The light deals an extra 1 point of damage per die to undead. The spirit light also affects incorporeal creatures normally. Prerequisite: A lantern-bearer must be at least 7th level before selecting this enhancement.
These abilities replace draw, astrology secret, lightspeed, royal road, the heavenly paths, spread, sect powers, synastry, divination, sleeve draw, and neutral sect.

features.name: Lantern Pool
features.text:
At 5th level, the lantern-bearer gains a reservoir of light energy within his lantern that he can draw upon to activate abilities. This lantern pool has a number of points equal to half his astrologian level + his Wisdom modifier. The pool refreshes once per day when the lantern-bearer rests for a full 8 hours. The lantern-bearer gains access to the Light school of spells as spell-like abilities that require lantern points equal to the spell level to use. A lantern-bearer’s caster level is equal to his level – 4. He gains access to all 1st-level Light spells at 5th level. Every three astrologian levels thereafter, he gains a new spell level.
This ability replaces minor arcana, far seer, and read the stars.

features.name: Lantern Refuel
features.text:
Also at 5th level, the lantern-bearer can regain his lantern pool quicker. The lantern-bearer must be relaxed and must be free from overt distractions, such as combat raging nearby or other loud noises. The lantern-bearer regains 1 lantern point per hour.
This ability replaces clear mind.

features.name: Additional Holy Essence Enhancements
features.text:
At 6th level, the lantern-bearer is able to apply a 2nd holy essence enhancement to his lantern’s light.
At 12th level, the lantern-bearer is able to apply a 3rd holy essence enhancement to his lantern’s light.
This ability replaces essential dignity and shuffle.

features.name: Extra Lantern’s Light
features.text:
At 7th level, as a full-round action, the lantern-bearer is able to produce an additional lantern’s light attack at a -5 penalty. At 14th level, he can produce a third lantern’s light attack at a -10 penalty. The lantern-bearer cannot use any light shape enhancements with the additional lantern’s lights.
This ability replaces do-over and astral guidance.

features.name: Critical Light
features.text:
At 14th level, the lantern-bearer’s aim becomes a precise deadliness. The critical threat range and multiplier of his lantern’s light ability increases by 1. This increase stacks with Improved Critical or Keen effects but applies after.
This ability replaces defy death.

name: Mystic
intro:
class="page-content">
The mystic believes that violence is sometimes necessary, but knowing and understanding is the true root of perfection. Through meditation and spiritual visions, a mystic can see beyond the veil of reality to the underlying truth of all existence.
The mystic is an archetype of the astrologian class.
Archetype Main Ability Scores:
The mystic mainly focuses on STR/DEX for combat with mystic bolts and WIS for their class features and spellcasting, as well as CHA for an optional class feature.
Archetype Feature Replacements:
1st – BAB, MP Pool, Spells, Draw, Limit Break (Kine

features.name: Limited Spellcasting
features.text: A mystic loses access to 7th through 9th level spells and has a lower Base MP as noted below.

features.name: Mystic Prowess
features.text: A mystic’s base attack bonus increases by one step (from 1/2 BAB to 3/4 BAB). Also increases mystic’s hit dice from d6 to d8.

features.name: Limit Break
features.text:
At 1st level, the mystic receives the Limit Break (Mystic Barrage).
Mystic Barrage (Su): This Limit Break allows the mystic to fire a barrage of mystic bolts at her enemies. The mystic fires a number of mystic bolts equal to half her astrologian level (minimum of 1, rounded down), but they deal half damage. If the mystic shoots multiple mystic bolts, she can have them strike a single creature or several creatures. A single mystic bolt can strike only one creature. The mystic bolts strikes unerringly, even if the target is in melee combat, so long as it has less than total cover or total concealment. Specific parts of a creature can’t be singled out.
This ability replaces the Limit Break (Kinetic Card).

features.name: Mystic Bolts
features.text:
A mystic can sling projectiles of magical energy at will by shooting a bolt or touching her foe. A melee mystic bolt requires the target to be within reach, and a ranged mystic bolt is a ranged attack with a range of 30 feet. A mystic bolt deals 1d6 points of damage plus an additional 1d6 for every four astrologian levels the mystic has after 1st.
The mystic must choose one type of damage for her mystic bolt: earth, fire, ice, lightning, water, or wind. Attacking with a mystic bolt takes the place of one of the mystic’s normal attacks, and she can make a full attack using mystic bolts. The mystic attacks with mystic bolts as though they were light one-handed weapons, and the bolts can be used for two-weapon fighting (with each hand creating one mystic bolt) and feats and abilities that apply to weapon attacks (unless they’re excluded from that feat, such as with Power Attack). Weapon Focus (ray) doesn’t apply to mystic bolts, but a mystic can take Weapon Focus (mystic bolt) and apply it to both melee and ranged mystic bolts.
Creating a mystic bolt requires the hand to be free, but the bolt appears only briefly, so a mystic using mystic bolts has a free hand any time she isn’t attacking with a mystic bolt.
The mystic threatens with a mystic bolt, but only if she has a hand free. Because mystic bolts are impermanent, a spell that targets a single weapon (like magic weapon) can’t affect it, nor can a mystic bolt be made with magic weapon special abilities. Abilities that affect all weapon attacks the mystic makes function with mystic bolts.
At 7th level and every six astrologian levels thereafter, the mystic chooses another damage type from the list above. Each time she creates a mystic bolt, she can have it use any one of the damage types she has selected.
This ability replaces star globe and draw.

features.name: Piercing Bolts
features.text:
At 3rd level, the mystic can choose one mystic bolt per round to be a touch attack. This turns a melee mystic bolt into a melee touch attack or a ranged mystic bolt into a ranged touch attack. At 10th level, the mystic can treat all of her mystic bolts as touch attacks.
This ability replaces lightspeed and divination.

features.name: Mystic Ki
features.text:
At 3rd level, a mystic gains a pool of ki points, supernatural energy she can use to accomplish amazing feats. The number of points in a mystic’s ki pool is equal to half her astrologian level + her Wisdom modifier. If the astrologian has at least 1 point of ki in her ki pool, she gains a +2 bonus on all Knowledge skill checks. As a swift action, the astrologian can spend 1 ki point immediately before making an ability, or skill check to gain a +4 insight bonus on the check.
This ability replaces anticipate danger and minor arcana.

features.name: Mystic Insight
features.text:
At 4th level, a mystic becomes apt at giving just the right word of advice in just the nick of time. As an immediate action, the astrologian can spend 2 ki points to grant an ally within 30 feet the ability to reroll a single attack roll or saving throw. The ally must be able to hear the astrologian to gain the reroll benefit.
This ability replaces royal road.

features.name: Mystic Visions
features.text:
At 8th level, a mystic may receive mystic visions when he rests. These visions can come as a dream, an epiphany, or even as the voice of an old friend whispering in the mystic’s mind. The effect is similar to a divination spell with a caster level equal to the astrologian’s level. The divination has no casting time; it is just part of the normal dreams or visions that occur every night. Using this ability costs 2 ki points that are removed from the next day’s total.
This ability replaces spread and sleeve draw.

features.name: Mystic Prescience
features.text:
At 12th level, a mystic gains a +2 insight bonus to AC and CMD. At 20th level, the bonus increases to +4.
This ability replaces shuffle.

features.name: Mystic Persistence
features.text:
At 18th level, a mystic can create an aura once per day as a swift action at the cost of at least 2 points of ki. The aura emanates out to a 20-foot radius. The mystic and all allies within the aura can roll two dice when making an attack roll or a saving throw and take the better result. The aura lasts for 1 round, plus an additional round for every 2 ki points spent when the mystic created the aura. The mystic can dismiss the aura at any time as a free action, but the ki points for the full duration of the aura are lost.
This ability replaces the astrology secret gained at 18th level.

features.name: Ascension
features.text:
At 20th level, the mystic becomes infused with the power of the heavens. She gains immunity to earth, ice, and petrification. She also gains resistance 10 to lightning and fire, as well as a +4 racial bonus on saving throws against poison.
This ability replaces master astrologian.

name: Oracle
intro:
class="page-content">
Although the gods work through many agents, perhaps none is more mysterious than the oracle. These divine vessels are granted power without their choice, selected by providence to wield powers that even they do not fully understand. Unlike a cleric, who draws her magic through devotion to a deity, oracles garner strength and power from many sources, namely those patron deities who support their ideals. Instead of worshiping a single source, oracles tend to venerate all of the gods that share their beliefs. While some see the powers of the oracle as a gift, others view the

features.name: Limit Break
features.text:
At 1st level, the oracle receives the Limit Break (Future Knowledge).
Future Knowledge (Su): This Limit Break allows the oracle to glimpse into the brief future to know how to best react. For the duration of 1 round + 1 round per four astrologian levels after 1st, the oracle receives a +1 circumstance bonus on Reflex saves and a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class per four astrologian levels after 1st. This limit break requires only a swift action.
This ability replaces the Limit Break (Kinetic Card).

features.name: Domains
features.text:
An oracle gains access to two domains of her choosing, gaining the domain abilities, using her astrologian level as her cleric level, and using her Wisdom modifier instead of Charisma for all domain-related abilties.
This ability replaces star globe.

features.name: Prescient Sense
features.text:
Starting at 1st level, if an oracle makes a successful Reflex saving throw against an attack that normally inflicts half damage on a successful save, she instead takes no damage, since her prescience allowed her to get out of the way faster. This form of evasion works no matter what armor the oracle wears, unlike the evasion ability used by monks and thieves.
This ability replaces draw.

features.name: Trap Sense
features.text:
At 3rd level, the oracle gains an intuitive sense that alerts her to danger from traps, giving her a +1 bonus on Reflex saves made to avoid traps and a +1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks made by traps. These bonuses rise to +2 when the oracle reaches 6th level, to +3 when she reaches 9th level, to +4 when she reaches 12th level, to +5 at 15th, and to +6 at 18th level. Trap sense bonuses gained from multiple classes stack.
This ability replaces lightspeed.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.text:
Starting at 4th level, an oracle gains the ability to react to danger before her senses would normally allow her to do so. She cannot be caught flat-footed, nor does she lose her Dex bonus to AC if the attacker is invisible. She still loses her Dexterity bonus to AC if immobilized. An oracle with this ability can still lose her Dexterity bonus to AC if an opponent successfully uses the feint action (see Combat) against her. If an oracle already has uncanny dodge from a different class, she automatically gains improved uncanny dodge (see below) instead.
This ability replaces royal road.

features.name: Divination Enhancement
features.text:
Beginning at 5th level, an oracle may roll twice and take the better result when using spells such as augury or divination.
This ability replaces minor arcana.

features.name: Swift Prediction
features.text:
At 6th level and above, for a number of times per day equal to her Wisdom modifier, an oracle may immediately predict the movements of an opponent and gain all the benefits of the True Strike spell as a swift action.
This ability replaces essential dignity.

features.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
features.text:
At 8th level and higher, the oracle can no longer be flanked. This defense denies a thief the ability to sneak attack the character by flanking her, unless the attacker has at least four more thief levels than the target does. If a character already has uncanny dodge (see above) from another class, the levels from the classes that grant uncanny dodge stack to determine the minimum thief level required to flank the character.
This ability replaces spread.

features.name: Momentary Glimpse
features.text:
At 12th level, once per day, the oracle can gain a glimpse into her immediate future. On the round after she uses this ability, she gains a +4 insight bonus on a single attack roll, saving throw, or skill check or to her Armor Class until the start of her next turn. At 14th level, and every two levels thereafter, she can use this ability one additional time per day.
This ability replaces shuffle.

features.name: Guiding Star
features.text:
At 10th level, whenever the oracle can see the open sky at night, she can determine her precise location. When the night sky is visible to the oracle, she may also add her Charisma modifier to her Wisdom modifier on all Wisdom-based checks. In addition, once per night while outdoors, she can cast one spell as if it were modified by the Empower Spell, Extend Spell, Silent Spell, or Still Spell feat without increasing the spell’s MP cost. At 15th and 20th level, she can cast an additional spell once per day.
This ability replaces divination and sleeve draw.

features.name: True Sight
features.text:
At 20th level, an oracle’s sight is imbued with True Seeing permanently.
This ability replaces master astrologian.

name: Sage
intro:
class="page-content">
The nation of Sharlayan is the cradle of knowledge, and the Studium its foremost institution of learning. Yet more so than its incomparable library and formidable assemblage of Archons, this prestigious academy is famed for blending traditionally distinct fields to produce revolutionary new disciplines. Among these, perhaps the most distinguished is an altruistic art which draws upon the wisdom of aetherology, sorcery, and medicine. Dubbed somanoutics, the art seeks to heal and protect by manipulating corporeal aether through the use of nouliths, a flying array of foci. P

features.name: Limit Breaks
features.text:
At 1st level, the sage receives the Limit Breaks (Panhaima and Pneuma).
Panhaima (Su): This Limit Break creates a regenerative barrier around all allies within 30-ft.-radius of the sage, granting them 1d6 temporary hit points plus an additional 1d6 temporary hit points per four astrologian levels after 1st. For 1 round + 1 round per four astrologian levels after 1st, all allies that gained temporary hit points from this Limit Break regain the same amount of temporary hit points at the start of her turn.
Pneuma (Su): This Limit Break causes the sage’s nouliths to go into overdrive and release a potent blast of aether, dealing 1d6 non-elemental damage plus an additional 1d6 non-elemental damage per two astrologian levels after 1st to all enemies within 30-ft.-radius of the sage. In addition, allies within the blast are healed for an amount equal to half the damage dealt.
These abilities replace the astrologian’s standard limit breaks.

features.name: Nouliths
features.text:
Beginning at 1st level, a sage creates an aetherial device which acts as a casting focus and versatile weapon. Available nouliths can be commanded to attack as a standard action, dealing 1d6 non-elemental damage. The sage must make a ranged touch attack that has a range of 25 feet + 5 ft. per two astrologian levels after 1st. Nouliths cannot be enhanced normally, nor do they have any materia slots. To make this attack, the sage may not be wielding any other weapon and must have one hand free.
At 6th level and every five astrologian levels thereafter, the sage can construct and control an additional noulith, allowing her to make one additional attack whenever she commands the nouliths to attack.
This ability replaces star globe, draw, minor arcana, sleeve draw and time dilation.

features.name: Kardia
features.text:
At 1st level, as a standard action, the sage can Kardion mark an ally, other than herself, within 30 feet. Whenever the sage deals damage to a hostile creature with her nouliths or casts a damaging spell, that marked ally heals for 1d4 and an additional +1 for each noulith the sage controls while within 30 feet of the sage. Only one creature may bear a Kardion mark at a time, and using this ability again will change the target.
This ability replaces prescience.

features.name: Dosis
features.text:
At 2nd level, the sage is capable of spending 1 MP to channel her aether through the nouliths to fire unerring projectiles acting like the Ruin spell. At 7th level, the sage can spend 4 MP to instead cast Ruinra. At 11th level, she can spend 6 MP to cast Ruinga.
This ability replaces forewarned.

features.name: Diagnosis
features.text:
At 2nd level, the sage is capable of weaving multiple protective magic into one spell. Whenever the sage casts any version of Shell or Protect, the other is cast at the same level without any MP cost. This feature may be used once per day plus one additional time for every four astrologian levels after 2nd.
This ability replaces fateful touch.

features.name: Academic Research
features.text:
At 2nd level, and every two astrologian levels thereafter, a sage advances her research to gain new capabilities. The sage must select a field of research from the list below. If a field of research is chosen at a later level, the sage gains all of the abilities and bonuses granted by that research based on her current level. Unless otherwise noted, the DC to save against these researches is equal to 10 + half of the astrologian’s level + her Wisdom modifier. Researches marked with an asterisk add effects to a sage’s spellcasting ability. Only one of these researchs can be applied to an individual spell and the decision must be made before the spell is cast. The sage may take Extra Astrology Secret feat to take extra academic researches.
Arcane Builder (Ex): The sage has an exceptional understanding of the theory behind creating magical items. She can select one type of magic item (alchemical items, wondrous items, and so on); she creates items of this type 25% faster than normal and gain a +4 bonus on Spellcraft checks (or other checks, as appropriate) to craft items of this type. She may select this research multiple times; its effects do not stack. Each time she selects this research, it applies to a different type of magic item.
Arcane Reservoir (Su): The sage gains an Arcane Reservoir as if she was a scholar of the same level as her astrologian level. The sage does not naturally gain any Scholarly Exploits but may select the Extra Scholar Exploit feat. The sage treats her astrologian level as scholar levels for all Scholarly Exploits and must meet her prerequisites. The sage does not gain the Consume MP class feature nor can she select Scholarly Exploits that rely on this ability. Prerequisite: The sage must not have an Arcane Reservoir to select this research.
Coil Overdrive (Ex): The sage’s nouliths become more potent through minor upgrades, increasing her damage die by one step (d6 to d8, d8 to d10, or d10 to d12). This research can be chosen for each noulith she can currently control, up to three times. Prerequisite: The sage must be at least 6th level to select this research.
Concentrate (Ex): The sage can reroll any concentration check she has just made with a +4 bonus. She must use this ability after the roll is made, but before the roll’s outcome is determined. The sage must take the second roll, even if it is worse. The sage can use this ability once per day.
Defensive Feedback (Su)*: Rather than dissipate damaging energy, the sage can redirect some of it back to its source. When an enhancing spell the sage casts prevents damage (with damage reduction or energy resistance), if the attacking creature is within 30 feet of the protected creature, the foe takes 1d6 points of damage for every 10 points of damage prevented.
Dyskrasia (Su): As a full-round action, the sage can command her nouliths to focus fire around a 10 ft. radius located somewhere within 25 ft. + 5 ft. for every two astrologian levels. All creatures inside this radius take 1d6 points of non-elemental damage per two astrologian levels. A successful Reflex saving throw (DC 10 + half of the astrologian’s level + her Wisdom modifier) halves this damage. The sage can do this a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Wisdom modifier.
Enhanced Nouliths (Su): The sage is able to enchant her nouliths. As a swift action, the nouliths gains a +1 enhancement bonus, which increases by 1 for every four astrologian levels beyond 2nd (to a maximum of +5 at 18th level). A sage can also use this ability to add the distance weapon special ability. Adding this special ability replaces an amount of enhancement bonus equal to the ability’s cost. The benefits are decided upon when the ability is used, and she cannot be changed unless the ability is used again. The sage cannot have more than one use of this ability active at a time. This effect lasts for a number of minutes equal to the sage’s Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Prerequisite: The sage must be at least 4th level to select this research.
Familiar (Ex): The sage forms a powerful bond with a familiar. A familiar is a magical pet that enhances the sage’s skills and senses and can aid in her magic. See this link for more information on familiars: Familiars
Far-Reaching Aid (Su): The sage’s range for applying her Kardia feature is increased to 60 feet. This also increases the range between her and the target of her Kardion mark for the purposes of healing.
Idealize (Su)*: The sage has discovered a way to further enhance herself and others. When an enhancing spell the sage casts grants an enhancement bonus to an ability score, that bonus increases by 2. At 20th level, the bonus increases by 4. Prerequisite: The sage must be at least 10th level to select this research.
Improved Enhancements (Ex)*: When the sage casts an enhancement spell, it’s highly effective in the first round. During the first round that the enhancement spell was cast, the effects are doubled. She may use this ability three times per day.
Mage Training: The sage may select an item creation or metamagic feat. The sage must still meet all prerequisites for a bonus feat, including caster level minimums. This research may be taken more than once. Each time, a different feat must be selected.
Mana Battery (Su): As a standard action, the sage can sacrifice her own magical font to store in her noulith as Addersgall. By spending 3 MP, the sage regains 1 point of Addersgall. The sage can do this a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Wisdom Modifier. Prerequisite: The sage must be at least 4th level to select this research.
Noulith Propulsion (Su): The sage’s noulith propulsion is so strong that her feet barely touch the ground. When the sage gains this research, she no longer leaves tracks. At 6th level, she can hover up to 5 inches above the ground or even above liquid surfaces, as if levitating. At 10th level, she gains the ability to fly, as per the spell, for a number of minutes per day equal to her astrologian level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments. Prerequisite: The sage must be at least 4th level to select this research.
Refractive Barrier (Su): The sage conjures a barrier that grants her a +2 deflection bonus to armor class. At 6th level, and every four astrologian levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +1. At 12th level, this barrier now stacks with the deflection bonus granted by the Protect spells. The sage can use this ability a number of hours per day equal to her astrologian level. The duration does not need to be consecutive, it can instead be spent in 1-hour increments. Prerequisite: The sage must be at least 4th level to select this research.
Rhizomata (Su): Once per combat encounter, as a free action, the sage can generate 1 point of Addersgall, not to exceed the maximum. Prerequisite: The sage must be at least 6th level to select this research.
Spell Lore (Ex): The sage adds her astrologian level to all Spellcraft checks made to identify a spell being cast. (This is most often useful when attempting to counterspell.)
Surecast (Su): The sage exercises caution when in danger, casting her spells with more care. While in a threatened square, she may choose to spend a full-round action to cast a spell, with a casting time of standard action or less. Doing so allows them to cast the spell without needing to cast it defensively. Prerequisite: The sage must have the Combat Casting feat to select this research.
Zoe (Su)*: As a free action, the sage adds an element of extra healing energy to any healing spell she casts. Affected targets gain Fast Healing equal to the level of the spell for a duration of 1 round + her Wisdom modifier. The sage may use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Wisdom modifier.
These abilities replace astrology secret and sect power.
replaces: amount of enhancement bonus equal to ’s cost

features.name: Addersgall
features.text:
At 3rd level, the sage is capable of storing raw aetherial energy in her noulith to be used later. When the sage rolls initiative, she gain 3 points of Addersgall, to a maximum of 3. Once the encounter ends, these points last for 1 minute before being lost. The sage can spend a point of Addersgall when casting a spell of 1st level or higher from the healing or enhancing schools. Those spells cost 1 MP less (to a minimum of 1).
This ability replaces lightspeed.

features.name: Eukrasia
features.text:
At 4th level, a sage is capable of augmenting her magical output. As a swift action, the sage can affect her next spell cast in the same round. If the next spell has a beneficial effect, allies affected will also gain a number of temporary hit points equal to twice the spell’s level for a duration of 1 round + Wisdom modifier. If enemy creatures are the target of a non-healing spell, then the effects are reversed (Such as Deshell when casting Shell).
This ability replaces royal road.

features.name: Prognosis
features.text:
At 5th level, the sage is capable of weaving stronger protective magics into one spell. Whenever the sage casts any version of Shellra or Protectra, the other is cast at the same level without any MP cost. This feature may be used once per day plus one additional time for every three astrologian levels after 5th.
This ability replaces heavenly path.

features.name: Virtuoso Academia
features.text:
At 6th level, the sage’s research and acquired knowledge transcends even traditional academia. She can use her Wisdom in place of Intelligence for Knowledge skill checks.
This ability replaces knowledge of the ages.

features.name: Kardion Burst
features.text:
At 7th level, once per day, the sage can amplify the effects of her Kardion mark when firing her nouliths. Rather than its usual effect, the subject of her Kardion mark heals hit point damage equal to the damage dealt by the nouliths. The creature then loses its Kardion mark.
This ability replaces astral guidance.

features.name: Converging Shot
features.text:
At 7th level, the sage can focus her noulith attacks to converge on a single target. When commanding them to fire in this way, the sage makes a ranged touch attack and combines the damage dice of all nouliths in her control. Additionally, she adds her Wisdom modifier once to the damage roll.
This ability replaces do-over.

features.name: Addersting
features.text:
At 8th level, the sage is able to store raw non-elemental energy in her nouliths. Whenever the sage uses a point of Addersgall, she gains a point of Addersting (to a maximum of 3). Once the encounter ends, these points last for 1 minute before being lost. The sage can spend a point of Addersting when attacking with her nouliths to add her Wisdom modifier as bonus damage to each noulith damage roll. When using the Converging Shot feature with Addersting, she may also reroll 1s for damage with all noulith dice in addition to the bonus damage.
This ability replaces spread.

features.name: Improved Kardia
features.text:
At 9th level, the sage is more adept at applying her Kardion mark. She may apply Kardia as a move action rather than a standard action. Furthermore, the sage can choose another target in range to apply the Kardion mark in place of her current target as a swift action.
This ability replaces synastry.

features.name: Icarus
features.text:
At 9th level, as a move action, the sage can jump to an ally. She travels in a straight line and must end in a space she can occupy adjacent to her target. The range of this ability is 50 ft. and will fail if there are any obstructions in the path. This ability can be used a number of times per day equal to her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).
This ability replaces future sight.

features.name: Toxikon
features.text:
At 10th level, the sage’s nouliths have been optimized to allow further destructive power. Whenever the sage casts a damaging spell or ability gained from astrologian levels, she can choose to spend 2 Addersting to have the spell or ability gain the benefits of the Maximize Spell metamagic without affecting the cost. At 17th level, the cost of this feature is reduced to 1 Addersting.
This ability replaces divination and chosen destiny.

features.name: Addershift
features.text:
At 12th level, the sage can now directly convert Addersgall into Addersting as a free action. Two points of Addersgall can be converted into a single point of Addersting.
This ability replaces tugging strands.

features.name: Adderstreak
features.text:
At 12th level, once per round, whenever the sage threatens a critical hit using her nouliths, she gains 1 Addersting (to a maximum of 3 Addersting).
This ability replaces shuffle.

features.name: Advanced Academic Research
features.text:
At 12th level, and every two astrologian levels thereafter, a sage can delve into more advanced subjects and theorems into the manipulation of Aether. She may choose one of the following Advanced Academic Research in place of an Academic Research. Fields of research marked with an asterisk add effects to a sage’s spellcasting ability. Only one of these researchs may be applied to an individual spell and the decision must be made before the spell is cast.
Dyskrasia II (Su): As a full-round action, the sage can command her nouliths to focus fire around a 10 ft. radius located somewhere within 25 ft. + 5 ft. for every two astrologian levels. All creatures inside this radius take 2d6 points of non-elemental damage per two astrologian levels. A successful Reflex saving throw (DC 10 + half of the astrologian’s level + her Wisdom modifier) halves this damage. The sage can do this a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Wisdom modifier. Prerequisite: The sage must have the Dyskrasia academic research to select this advanced research.
Effortless Healing (Ex): The sage has learned to cast healing spells with minimal effort. She may cast such spells without provoking attacks of opportunity. This ability applies only to healing spells that she casts as a sage, not to those that she may have by virtue of levels in another class.
Enhanced Kerachole (Su): Whenever the sage uses her Kerachole ability, affected allies gain Fast Healing 2 for a number of rounds equal to the sage’s Wisdom modifier. Prerequisite: The sage must have the Kerachole class feature to select this advanced research.
Healing Hands (Ex): Whenever a sage casts a spell that heals hit point damage, she adds her Wisdom modifier to the amount of damage healed.
Improved Adderstreak (Su): The sage can gain Addersting an additional time in a single round from Adderstreak, instead of only once per round.
Mage Counter (Su)*: When the sage uses dispel to counterspell, she gain a +4 competence bonus to her dispel check. Prerequisite: The sage must know the Dispel spell to select this advanced research.
Protective Ward (Su)*: Whenever the sage casts an enhancement spell, you or an ally within 30 feet gains a +2 sacred bonus to AC for a number of rounds equal to the level of the spell cast.
Somanoutic Oath (Ex): The sage’s Kardia feature now triggers from Spell-like and Supernatural features gained from astrologian levels that deal damage.
Soteria (Ex): The sage’s healing from Kardia and Kardion Burst features are doubled.
These abilities replace advanced astrology secrets.

features.name: Noulith Capacitance
features.text:
At 13th level, the sage can accumulate aether in her nouliths after each shot to release at just the right time. Each successful attack now increases the critical hit range of the sage’s noulith by 1 until a critical hit is rolled, then it resets. This bonus is applied after Improved Critical, but otherwise stacks.
This ability replaces foretell.

features.name: Pepsis
features.text:
Beginning at 13th level, the sage may end the effects of any version of Shell or Protect, including Shellra and Protectra, from allies within a 50 ft. range as a swift action. For each effect ended, the target heals for 1d6 per spell level.
This ability replaces far seer.

features.name: Kerachole
features.text:
At 14th level, as an Immediate action, when the sage or any number of allies within 30 ft. take damage from a single source (such as an area of effect), the sage can spend 1 point of Addersgall to deploy an emergency barrier which reduces the damage taken by all allies affected equal to her Wisdom modifier. This reduction of damage is calculated before resistances.
This ability replaces defy death.

features.name: Targeting Systems
features.text:
At 15th level, the sage’s nouliths gain improved targeting systems. Her critical hit range is increased by 1. This stacks with Noulith Capacitance, Improved Critical and similar abilities but is calculated after all other modifiers.
This ability replaces neutral sect.

features.name: Krasis
features.text:
Starting at 17th level, the sage may, as a free action, select a single creature she can see to gain the benefits of this feature. Healing spells that affect this creature are treated as if the sage was casting with the Intensified Spell metamagic without increasing its cost. The ability has a duration of rounds equal to half of her astrologian levels and can be used three times per day.
This ability replaces read the stars.

features.name: Holos
features.text:
At 18th level, the sage creates a 30-ft.-radius barrier over herself, centered on her. It lasts a number of rounds equal to her Wisdom modifier, and while inside the barrier, the sage and her allies gain temporary hit points equal to her astrologian levels at the start of her turn and damage is reduced by 50%. The sage must focus on this ability as a full-round action each round otherwise the ability drops. This ability is usable only once per day, even if it ended prematurely.
This ability replaces collective unconscious.

features.name: Phlegma
features.text:
At 19th level, the sage can have her nouliths concentrate upon one creature within 100 ft. That creature, and all creatures and objects adjacent, take 8d6 non-elemental damage and become Imperiled to an element of her choice, a successful Will save (DC 10 + half of the astrologian’s level + her Wisdom modifier) reduces damage by half and ignores the Imperil status. She can use this ability a number of times per day equal to her Wisdom modifier.
This ability replaces the heavens to us.

features.name: Expert Diagnosis
features.text:
At 19th level, the sage has reached the pinnacle of protecting her allies. The sage targets an ally and grants them the benefits of: Haste, Protect V, Reflect, Regen V, and Shell V for 1d4 rounds. The duration of the spells cast by this feature cannot be augmented. This action shares uses per day with Diagnosis.
This ability replaces destiny realized.

features.name: Perfect Prognosis
features.text:
Starting at 20th level, the sage has perfected the art of widespread protection. All allies within 30 ft. gain the benefits of: Hastega, Protectra IV, Reflectga, Renew IV, and Shellra IV for 1d4 rounds. The duration of the spells cast by this feature cannot be augmented. This action shares uses per day with Prognosis.
This ability replaces master astrologian.

name: Star Sibyl
intro:
class="page-content">
Star Sibyls guide the tarutaru people by reading the moon and the stars to foresee future events. They wear a blue orb called the Diza Star which is essential to the application of their powers.
The star sibyl is an archetype of the astrologian class, available only to tarutaru astrologians.

features.name: Prerequisite
features.text: The star sibyl must have the magic resistant racial trait.

features.name: Diza Star
features.text:
At 1st level, a star sibyl begins play with an item called a Diza Star which is worn as a necklace. While wearing this item, she gains a +1 DC on all astrologian spells she casts and a +1 caster level. If stolen or destroyed, the star sibyl can recreate one by spending 100 gil per astrologian level. Only the star sibyl is able to get this bonus.
This ability replaces star globe.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.text:
At 1st level, a star sibyl’s magic resistant racial trait increases, granting her a spell resistance of 12 + her astrologian level.
This ability replaces prescience.

features.name: Sibyl’s Fortune
features.text:
At 2nd level, when the star sibyl activates this ability, she can touch any creature as a standard action to give it an insight bonus on all of its attack rolls, skill checks, ability checks, and saving throws equal to half her astrologian level (minimum +1) for 1 round. The star sibyl can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Wisdom modifier.
This ability replaces fateful touch.

features.name: Send Senses
features.text:
At 3rd level, as a standard action, the star sibyl places a scrying sensor at a point within medium range (100 feet + 10 feet/astrologian level) that she can see and have line of effect to. The star sibyl can see or hear (not both) through this sensor for number of rounds equal to half her astrologian level (minimum 1). The sensor otherwise functions as a clairaudience/clairvoyance spell with a caster level equal to her astrologian level. The star sibyl can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Wisdom modifier.
This ability replaces lightspeed.

features.name: Inspiring Prediction
features.text:
At 4th level, a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Wisdom modifier, the star sibyl can predict an ally’s success, bolstering others’ resolve. As a swift action, the star sibyl can shout an inspiring prediction, granting each ally within 50 feet who can hear her a +4 luck bonus on her next attack roll, saving throw, or skill check.
This ability replaces insight.

features.name: Star Reading
features.text:
At 6th level, a number of times per day equal to her Wisdom modifier, the star sibyl can publicly declare that her next spell is guided by prophecy. When the star sibyl does, the next spell she casts has a 20% chance of fizzling (1–20 on a d%). If the spell does not fail, treat the spell as if it had been modified by the Empower Spell feat, even if the star sibyl does not have that feat. At 12th level, the chance that the spell fizzles is reduced to 15% (1–15 on a d%). At 16th level, the chance is reduced to 10% (1–10 on a d%).
This ability replaces essential dignity.

features.name: Scrying Adept
features.text:
At 9th level, the star sibyl is always aware when she is being observed via magic. In addition, whenever the star sibyl scries on a subject, treat the subject as one step more familiar to the star sibyl. Very familiar subjects get a –10 penalty on their save to avoid her scrying attempts.
This ability replaces synastry.

features.name: Eldritch Vision
features.text:
At 12th level, the star sibyl gains magical vision that grants her the ability to see invisible opponents including those that may be ethereal. This effect is constant, though the star sibyl may voluntarily drop or restart the effect as a move action. Otherwise, it operates as the See Invisibility spell. The star sibyl also gains a +4 bonus versus Illusions and are allowed a saving throw when she first encounters the illusion if it is of the Figment or Glamer subschools.
This ability replaces tugging strands.

features.name: Touch the Infinite Veil
features.text:
At 16th level, the star sibyl may reach out to the powers beyond time and space and ask a question regarding the present or near present that has a simple answer, such as yes, no, or a short phrase. It is possible that no real answer may be given. The star sibyl must spend 1 minute in meditation to initiate this power and may only ask one question, but otherwise it is identical to the Commune spell. The star sibyl may use this power a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Wisdom modifier.
This ability replaces time dilation.

name: Stargazer
intro:
class="page-content">
An astrologian who spends much time studying the paths of the stars will discover the most truly influential domains of the heavens: the constellations of the zodiac. These twelve signs dominate the events of the world from behind the scenes, and they call for a finely attuned spirit to best mark their passing. Stargazers are devotees of this kind, and their knowledge of the celestial sphere is unmatched.
The stargazer is an archetype of the astrologian class.
Archetype Main Ability Scores:
The stargazer mainly focuses on DEX for combat and WIS for their class features an

features.name: Limit Break
features.text:
At 1st level, the stargazer receives the Limit Break (Sidereal Stream).
Sidereal Stream (Su): This Limit Break allows the stargazer to unleash stellar energies in a 60-ft.-line. Enemies within the area of effect take 2d6 points of elemental damage (based on the stargazer’s zodiac constellation) plus an additional 2d6 per four astrologian levels after 1st. A successful Reflex save (DC 10 + half of the astrologian’s level + his Wisdom modifier) halves the damage. In addition, if enemies fail the saving throw, they suffer a -1 penalty to AC, attacks, checks, damage, and saves for 1d4 rounds; this penalty increases by1 per four astrologian levels after 1st.
This ability replaces the Limit Break (Kinetic Card).

features.name: Constellation Pool
features.text: At 1st level, the stargazer gains a reservoir of mystical stellar energy that he can draw upon to fuel his powers and enhance his weapon with elemental damage. This constellation pool has a number of points equal to half his astrologian level (minimum 1) + his Wisdom modifier. The pool refreshes once per day when the stargazer rests for a full 8 hours.

features.name: Zodiac
features.text:
At 1st level, the stargazer selects a major zodiac constellation with which he is most closely tied. Each constellation is associated with a season of the year, as well as with one of four elements.
Spring:
• 
Aries: fire
• 
Taurus: earth
• 
Gemini: wind
Summer:
• 
Cancer: water
• 
Leo: fire
• 
Virgo: earth
Autumn:
• 
Libra: wind
• 
Scorpio: water
• 
Sagittarius: fire
Winter:
• 
Capricorn: earth
• 
Aquarius: wind
• 
Pisces: water
Each season has an associated zodiac aura bonus, which the stargazer may activate by expending a constellation pool point as a swift action. For a number of rounds equal to his Wisdom modifier, the stargazer then emits a major zodiac aura with a radius of 30 feet with the following effects:
• 
Spring: Grants the stargazer and his allies Fast Healing up to 50% health.
• 
Summer: Grants the stargazer and his allies a circumstance bonus to Attack rolls.
• 
Autumn: Grants the stargazer and his allies a circumstance bonus to Saving Throws.
• 
Winter: Grants the stargazer and his allies DR/—.
Each bonus has a value of 1 at 1st level. This value increases by 1 at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th levels, to a maximum of 5 at 17th level.
At 1st level, the stargazer also gains an elemental resistance of 2, with the element corresponding to his major zodiac constellation. This resistance value increases by 2 at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th levels, to a maximum of 10 at 17th level. He may also expend a constellation pool point as a swift action to imbue his weapon (including his star globe) with this element for an additional 1d4 elemental damage per tier, for a maximum of 5d4 at 17th level; this effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to the stargazer’s Wisdom modifier.
At 10th level, the stargazer may choose a second constellation as a minor zodiac. All minor zodiac aura and elemental resistance benefits he and his allies receive from this second constellation are like those of his first, but have half their value rounded down. He may choose which aura he emits when expending his constellation pool point; alternatively, he may choose to emit his major and minor auras simultaneously by expending 3 constellation pool points (instead of 1). When another ability refers to the stargazer’s zodiac constellation, he may select either major or minor constellation to fulfill its terms. The stargazer may not choose a second constellation from the same season or with the same elemental affiliation as his first. Elemental damage of different types may not be stacked on the same weapon(s); imbuing a weapon with any element in this way will replace the first with the new one with a fresh duration.
This ability replaces draw, minor arcana, divination, and sleeve draw.
replaces: first with new one with fresh duration

features.name: Solstice
features.text:
At 4th level, the stargazer may expend, as a swift action, up to his Wisdom modifier in constellation pool points to extend the duration and radius of his zodiac aura. The duration is increased by a number of rounds equal to 2 for every constellation pool point expended; the radius increases by 5 feet for every equal amount spent.
This ability replaces royal road.

features.name: Equinox
features.text:
At 8th level, the stargazer may pass on his stellar energies to his allies. By expending 1 constellation pool point per target, up to his Wisdom modifier, he may imbue his allies’ weapons with his chosen constellation’s element within a radius of 30 ft. His allies’ imbued weapons deal 1d4 elemental damage for every four astrologian levels after 1st, to a maximum of 5d4 at 17th level. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to his Wisdom modifier. The stargazer may use this ability a number of times per day equal to his Wisdom modifier.
This ability replaces spread.

features.name: Quickening
features.text:
At 12th level, the stargazer learns how to unleash stellar energies as a direct attack. By expending a constellation pool point as a swift action, the stargazer attacks with his zodiac constellation’s element as though it were a breath weapon. This attack fills a 15-foot cone and deals 6d6 damage of that element—this damage increases by 1d6 for every two astrologian levels beyond 12th. A creature hit by the stargazer’s quickening can attempt a Reflex save (DC 10 + half of the astrologian’s level + his Wisdom modifier) to take half damage. At 12th level, the stargazer can use this ability once per day; at 15th, he can use it twice per day; at 18th, he can use it three times per day.
This ability replaces shuffle.

features.name: Epoch
features.text:
At 16th level, the base radius of the stargazer’s zodiac auras increases to 60 feet. In addition, all enemies within a 30-ft.-radius of the stargazer suffer negative effects corresponding to the season of his zodiac constellation(s):
• 
Spring: Drains health per turn.
• 
Summer: Suffers a penalty to Attack rolls.
• 
Autumn: Suffers a penalty to Saving Throws.
• 
Winter: Suffers a penalty to AC.
The value of these penalties are equivalent to those of his zodiac aura bonuses. If the stargazer has his minor zodiac aura active, his minor constellation likewise inflicts half the penalty value.
This ability replaces time dilation.

features.name: Ophiuchus
features.text:
At 20th level, the stargazer becomes associated with the hidden 13th zodiac symbol. The stargazer gains DR/— with a value equal to his Wisdom modifier and 5 points of shadow elemental resistance; he may also imbue his or his allies’ weapons with the dark element as he would with his zodiac and equinox abilities. In addition, he becomes immune to fear effects and to critical hits.
This ability replaces master astrologian.

name: Stellarian
intro:
class="page-content">
The stars guide the planets with gravity, create life with light and heat, and utterly consume worlds in supernovas and black holes. The stellarian understands that these acts of creation and destruction are not opposites, but rather two parts of a natural, dualistic cycle. The stellarian seeks to be an agent of that cycle, an enlightened warrior with the ability to manipulate the forces of the stars themselves. Constantly accompanied by a mote of fundamental energy or entropy, the stellarian can shape this essence in combat to create weapons and armor of gleaming stellar

features.name: Charismatic Astromancer
features.text: A stellarian uses his Charisma modifier instead of Wisdom for all other astrologian class features not replaced.

features.name: Class Skills
features.text: The stellarian gains Acrobatics, Bluff, and Diplomacy as class skills, but loses all Knowledge skills except for Dungeoneering and Local as class skills.

features.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiencies
features.text:
A stellarian gains proficiency with simple and martial weapons. A stellarian also gains proficiency in light armor, medium armor, and shields (except tower shields).
This ability replaces the astrologian’s standard weapon and armor proficiencies.

features.name: Combat Prowess
features.text:
A stellarian’s base attack bonus increases by two steps (from 1/2 BAB to Full BAB). Also increases the stellarian’s hit dice from d6 to d10. In addition, the stellarian’s Fortitude save progression becomes good.
This ability replaces spells, and MP Pool. Stellarians do not gain any spells or spellcasting ability, do not have a caster level, and do not count as having an astrologian spell list for spell trigger or spell completion magic items.

features.name: Limit Breaks
features.text:
At 1st level, the stellarian receives the Limit Breaks (Cosmic Abyss and Solar Storm).
Cosmic Abyss (Su): This Limit Break allows the stellarian to cause a spatial implosion at a visible space within 100 feet as a standard action. The abyss is a stationary, visible shroud of void occupying a 20ft radius. When an enemy begins its turn in its radius or enters it, they must make a fortitude save (DC 10 + half of his astrologian level + his Charisma modifier + the enemy’s size CMD bonus/penalty) or be moved 5ft closer to the center of the abyss (the four central tiles), also taking 2d6 bludgeoning damage plus 2d6 per four astrologian levels after 1st. This damage is doubled in the aforementioned center. Enemies within the radius have their speeds set to 5 feet and cannot take 5-foot steps.
